text:
deploy-bot: ALERT: canary /v2/generate p95 +40% vs baseline (5m). Autorevert candidate: rollback -> v3.4.2. Options: rollback canary, throttle, or ignore. details: https://telemetry.internal/alerts/1718450001

Alice: noticing client timeouts in EU too. Support seeing errors.

Bob: threshold is 25%. This is noisy at 40% for 5m. Autorevert is configured but requires human confirm for canary-slice.

Claire: prefer targeted canary rollback for eu only. Do not touch prod routing. We'll need a tiny release-note edit.

Dave: ready to run. Command I will use:
```
releases rollback --to v3.4.2 --scope canary --selectors region=eu --note "p95 regression"
```
I'll hold 90s for objections.

Erin: +1 from support. 6 customers filed timeouts in last 8m. Throttling might worsen tail latency.

Bob: agree, throttling is risky. rollback safer.

Alice: go ahead. I'll draft internal and customer copy. Keep legal in the loop.

legal-bot: Ensure audit_id is captured and add exact rollback log to the compliance bucket. Tag legal if message to customers references "regression" or internal root cause.

Dave: running now. Tail of command log:
```
$ releases rollback --to v3.4.2 --scope canary --selectors region=eu --note "p95 regression"
Rolling back canary slice [eu] to v3.4.2...
- draining connections -> OK
- switch routing -> OK
- smoke verify -> p95 back to baseline within 90s
Rollback done. audit_id=rb-20240402-9902
```

Alice: Verified telemetry shows p95 back to normal. :white_check_mark:

Erin: support update posted, tickets flagged, customers on impacted list notified with templated blurb.

Claire: created ENG-4722 for root cause investigation and regression bisect. Attaching audit_id and logs. Will prep release-note patch and mark as "post-rollback note."

Bob: follow ups: (1) keep prod pinned, (2) perf bisect on canary diff, (3) prepare hotfix branch if needed.

Dave: adding rollback audit to the release audit and closing this thread once ENG-4722 has an owner.

Alice: assigned to SRE team (Erin, Bob). Reopen if any new signals. Thanks all.

deploy-bot: NOTE: autorevert was suppressed by operator override at execution time.
